mapper.select: SELECT id,payload,version FROM godp_planning_item_read WHERE slot_type='hotspot' AND runtime_active='true' AND content_status='unassigned' AND topic_id='' AND publish_date=#{publishDate} AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,payload,version FROM godp_planning_item_read WHERE content_status='awaiting_market' AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM godp_planning_resource_claim WHERE del_flag='N' AND resource_kind=#{kind} AND resource_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE godp_planning_item SET payload=#{payload},content_status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expected} AND content_status IN ('unassigned','awaiting_market')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM godp_planning_item_read WHERE account_id=#{account} AND publish_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND topic_type='营销'
